definitions.explanation: The ability to control or influence others, especially through official or institutional means. Often refers to political or governmental power.

examples.japanese: {権力|けんりょく}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{握|にぎ}る→握る：02383_nigiru⟧。
{権力|けんりょく}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{乱用|らんよう}→乱用：15259_ranyou⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{許|ゆる}されない→許す：02325_yurusu⟧。
examples.english: Abuse of power is not permitted.

examples.japanese: {権力|けんりょく}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{持|も}つ→持つ：00478_motsu⟧⟦{者|もの}→者：12734_mono⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧、⟦その→その：00993_sono⟧⟦{責任|せきにん}→責任：03298_sekinin⟧⟦も→も：00484_mo⟧⟦{負|お}う→負う：02017_ou⟧べき⟦である→である：09855_dearu⟧。
examples.english: Those who hold power should also bear the responsibility.

notes:
{権力|けんりょく} refers to power in the sense of control or authority, especially political power.

FORMS:
{権|けん} (right, authority) + {力|りょく} (power) = power/authority

COMMON EXPRESSIONS:
- {権力|けんりょく}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{握|にぎ}る→握る：02383_nigiru⟧: to seize power
- {権力|けんりょく}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{持|も}つ→持つ：00478_motsu⟧: to hold power
- {権力|けんりょく}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{行使|こうし}→行使：14087_koushi⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧: to exercise power
- {権力|けんりょく}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{乱用|らんよう}→乱用：15259_ranyou⟧: abuse of power
- {権力|けんりょく}⟦{争|あらそ}い→争い：09992_arasoi⟧: power struggle
- {権力|けんりょく}{者|しゃ}: person in power

COMPOUNDS:
- ⟦{国家|こっか}→国家：02760_kokka⟧{権力|けんりょく}: state power
- ⟦{行政|ぎょうせい}→行政：14122_gyousei⟧{権力|けんりょく}: executive power
- ⟦{司法|しほう}→司法：09663_shihou⟧{権力|けんりょく}: judicial power
